name: mirage
text: ParlayAPI Pro: of the ~7,300 credits used, the engine itself spent only 363 (134 calls on that key). The other ~6,900 is not the engine's ledger. That is my inference, not something I measured: the likeliest source is the three one-off test runs on Oct 20-21 (the Pro probe, the arbitrage scan of 6 sports and the live listen, run 00:18-01:01 UTC). The engine's own pace is about 190 credits an hour, which would last the rest of this billing month (resets Nov 1) with room to spare. I'm not cutting anything blind: the API-quality journal in v1.0.34 records which ParlayAPI calls gave lines no other API gave, and I'll trim only what proves redundant. No more test runs from me on that key.
